item_short_desc: Celebrate your pride with the Black Ink U.S.M.C. Bulldog T-Shirt, a must-have for any Marine Corps enthusiast. This heavyweight t-shirt is made from 100% super-soft cotton, ensuring maximum comfort and durability. The two-sided print features a fierce bulldog graphic on the front and the iconic U.S.M.C. logo on the back, making a bold statement. Pre-shrunk for a perfect fit, this t-shirt maintains its shape and size after multiple washes. Officially licensed by the United States Marine Corps.
